config.scope: SOURCE DEVELOPMENT only E01/E02/E03, fixed A03/A07/A12; articulation only, no absolute hip-root position, E04 or 3D
config.recurrence: state=rho*(previous+gain*corrected_delta)+(1-rho)*corrected_RFpose; first/gap resets to current corrected_RFpose. No ground-truth initial state
config.view: Shared 2x2 map on centered reference increments, Ridge towards identity: lambda=.5*(predicted_energy+true_energy), minimum1e-12. Joint/room-specific nonlinear mapping and 3D geometry are not fitted
config.reference_budget: 120unique labeled poses:2people x3actions x10lag8pairs x2poses;60reference increments. Same labels for all calibrated controls
config.reference_selection_limit: Source-validation reference people are training people of the frozen decoder. Held-room reference people are unseen by that decoder; residual calibration selection can be optimistic
config.selection: Minimum pooled source-validation articulation NJE; refs TRAINpeople1/2, different query people4/9. Independent selectors for corrected_RFpose, no_motion_filter, static_anchor. First grid tie. Freeze all3fold choices before held-query scoring
config.limitations: Development rotations reuse source rooms, represented3actions/one seed. Static configuration comes from RFpose head, not motion integration alone; complete absolute pose, new-action or calibrated product efficacy are not established
